It emphasizes the importance of moral virtues and good character in every dimension of life. This includes conducting oneself with integrity, treating others with kindness and respect, and striving for excellence and perfection at all times. It is a name that resonates deeply with the Islamic values of compassion, generosity, and a love for all of God's creations.
